description: Apply for free CGBB membership on behalf of a brand. Returns an application_id, a domain-verification token and next steps. A real person at the brand (contact_email) must confirm by email; the CGBB Secretariat then reviews it. Only apply for a brand the user represents, using that brand’s own website domain and the work email of a real person there who agreed to be contacted. The free Member level is not a certification, rating or endorsement.

about.description: Short introduction to the brand (max 1200 characters)

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or tool making the application

applied_by.description: Optional: the agency or partner organisation applying on the brand’s behalf, e.g. its PR or marketing agency

contact_email.description: A real person at the brand who will confirm by email

domain.description: The brand’s own website domain, e.g. brand.com

lang.description: Language for emails and pages: en, zh (Traditional Chinese) or zh-Hans (Simplified Chinese)

organisation.description: Legal or brand name of the organisation

name: apply_for_membership
title: Apply for free CGBB membership
